name: 03077 · Raymond, NH
findings: ZIP 03077 (Raymond) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03077 (Raymond) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
